name: SpiralHookV2 spot-price borrow with tx.origin same-block guard
summary: SpiralHookV2.borrow values SPIRAL collateral at the live Uniswap V4 slot0 price of its own pool, and its only same-block defence keys lastSwapBlockOf on tx.origin. The attacker pumped the pool with 54 ETH from one EOA, then borrowed against the bought SPIRAL at the inflated spot from six other EOAs through one contract in the same block, withdrawing 64.71 ETH of hook-owned liquidity.
notes: Immutable hook runtime: spot-price collateral valuation and tx.origin-keyed same-block guard are code constants; owner launch steps (initializePool, seedBands, openTrading) set no defect-creating value.

Net loss: the attacker's 54 ETH pump went into the same hook-owned liquidity that the borrows withdrew, so the loss is the attacker's net ETH gain (64.70728098661343541 ETH borrowed minus 54 ETH paid in), equal to the protocol's net ETH depletion because the swap and origination fees stayed with protocol fee recipients. Unrepaid debt is not added and the SPIRAL collateral left behind is not netted.
